reference_sql:
SELECT product_name, unit_cost_eur,
       CASE WHEN unit_cost_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN unit_cost_eur >= 100 THEN 'premium'
            ELSE 'budget'
       END AS cost_band
FROM products
WHERE brand = 'Sonora'
